False positive: "unlicensed" as an ordinary word (known issue)

Correct popup result: Missing — this notice grants no rights and names no license at all.

Actual current result: Unlicense (mapped to the publicDomain category), because license-db.js's NAME_TO_SPDX pattern for the Unlicense is a bare, unanchored /unlicense/ regex, which matches "unlicensed" as a substring. This is security-relevant: the default allowed-categories list includes publicDomain, so with blocking enabled this script would be let through even though it explicitly grants no rights. Enabling "Block scripts whose license was only guessed" in Options (see README "Limitations") defends against this specific case, since the category came from a guess.
